title: EFT_Operator_Scan: code and data deposit for the photon-dark matter effective-operator scan
description: Code, production sensitivity grids, calibration and expected-band outputs, and fixed random seeds that reproduce every figure of arXiv:2608.29546, "Photon-Dark Matter Elastic Scattering: An Effective-Operator Scan and First Operator-Resolved Sensitivity Estimates from the Galactic Halo".
